requiredOwnMaskSemantics: Palace roofs and facades255; courtyards, ground, sky, trees, distant blocks, people, text, statues including equestrian statue0. Fill only palace parts occluded by intervening objects, not empty courtyard holes.
ownMaskProvenanceRequired: Trace actual new photograph first. Keep independent source mask byte-immutable; do not return a copy of target mask to claim100%IoU. Any inferred hidden palace extent must be separately marked.
measurement: At exact output dimensions without crop/warp/scale alignment: count own AND source mask pixels, own OR source mask pixels; IoU=intersection/union. Save counts, SHA and difference image.
LiDARExceptions: Only individually described conspicuous measurement spikes/errors; no blanket allowance for changed wings, domes or camera. No exception predeclared.
outputCameraClaim: Locked input matrix/metadata is not proof that an image model recreated the physical camera. Verify landmark and silhouette correspondence from output; no field-survey claim.
failureHandling: Stop after first whole image for feedback; no partial repairs or automatic retries. Never mark failed resolution/silhouette as passed.
